    PLA Setup Framework

    What It Takes to Run High-Performing Product Listing Ads

    Google Shopping success isn’t luck — it’s built on the right foundation, precise setup, and continuous optimization. Here’s how we build campaigns that actually perform.

    01

    Website Readiness

    Your eCommerce store must have approved products, clear policies, and a seamless structure. Google relies on your website data, so compliance is critical for approvals and performance.

    02

    Google Ads Account Setup

    A properly structured Google Ads account with accurate conversion tracking ensures better campaign efficiency and measurable ROI.

    03

    Google Merchant Center Account

    Your product feed lives here. We configure and optimize Merchant Center to ensure accurate listings and eligibility for Google Shopping placements.

    04

    Product Feed Optimization & Tracking

    Titles, images, and attributes directly impact performance. We refine your feed and implement tracking to measure real conversions.

    05

    Continuous Optimization

    Success comes from iteration. We optimize bids, refine search terms, and continuously improve performance to scale your ROI.

    Types of Google Shopping Ads

    We leverage multiple Shopping ad formats to maximize visibility, capture high-intent buyers, and drive measurable eCommerce growth.

    Product Shopping Ads

    Standard Shopping ads showcasing individual products with images, pricing, and store details — designed to capture ready-to-buy users.

    Showcase Shopping Ads

    Display multiple related products in one expandable unit, perfect for discovery-stage searches and category browsing.

    Local Inventory Ads

    Promote in-store availability to nearby shoppers with real-time inventory, helping drive foot traffic and local conversions.
